summary: Treat Neon's echoed cursor on an empty final page as end of list, and record per-project usage snapshots after a clean projects+branches sync.
reason: Generated sticky-cursor guard aborted projects/operations sync as stuck, so they were never marked complete; consumption history is plan-gated (Launch/Scale), so usage commands need snapshot data.
validated_outcome: Live sync against an org API key completes projects/branches/endpoints/operations with no stuck_pagination warnings; snapshot tests in neon_usage_snapshots_test.go.
